A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the data on diffractive $c\over-line {c}$ production at HERA are in good agreement with perturbative QED and QCD.
the diffractive $F_2^D$ data can discriminate between the sets of gluons and the diffractive structure functions $F_2^{D(3)}$ can discriminate between the proton gluons.
